facts.text: All baccalaureate students must complete at least four University Interdisciplinary Studies courses across four breadth categories, totaling a minimum of 12 credits, to graduate.

sources.title: University Interdisciplinary Studies - University of Hartford
sources.quote: All students in baccalaureate programs are required to take at least four University Interdisciplinary Studies courses, from each of the four breadth categories (for a minimum of 12 UIS credits) over their four years as part of graduation requirements.
